description: This file defines the XSize struct, which represents a pair of floating-point numbers typically used for dimensions like width and height in graphical operations within the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors, comparison operators, conversions to other types, parsing, and utility methods relevant to size representations.

classes.name: XSize
classes.description: A struct representing a size with width and height as double-precision floating-point numbers. It provides methods for comparison, parsing, conversion, and string representation relevant to graphical sizes.

methods.name: XSize(double width, double height)
methods.description: Constructor initializing size with specified width and height, throws if either is negative.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Checks equality between two XSize instances.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two XSize instances.

methods.name: Equals(XSize, XSize)
methods.description: Static method to determine if two sizes are equal.

methods.name: Equals(object o)
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare with another object.

methods.name: Equals(XSize)
methods.description: Checks equality with another XSize instance.

methods.name: GetHashCode()
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on size values.

methods.name: Parse(string source)
methods.description: Parses a string to create an XSize instance.

methods.name: ToXPoint()
methods.description: Converts this size to an XPoint.

methods.name: ToXVector()
methods.description: Converts this size to an XVector.

methods.name: ToSize()
methods.description: Converts this size to a System.Windows.Size (WPF/WUI).

methods.name: FromSize(System.Drawing.Size)
methods.description: Creates an XSize from a System.Drawing.Size.

methods.name: FromSizeF(System.Drawing.SizeF)
methods.description: Creates an XSize from a SizeF.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the size.

methods.name: ConvertToString(string?, IFormatProvider?)
methods.description: Helper method to generate formatted string.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Returns an empty size instance with negative infinity dimensions.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the size is empty.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Property to get or set the width, not modifiable if empty.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Property to get or set the height, not modifiable if empty.
